object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a req-test copy, write .git/MERGE_HEAD to put a merge in progress; separately, give the server no git identity. Call edit_description with a commit_message. Expected: the result holds commit_error with a reason naming the merge, or the missing identity. Probe, with the merge: ok true and commit_error {error: 'a merge (or another git operation) is in progress; finish the merge in your git client, then commit again', error_type: 'GitError'}. GitError isn't in MELLON-MCP-SRS-55's table.
